moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks This Week
moments.blurb: A significant heatwave is forecast for much of the UK this week, with central and southern England potentially seeing temperatures over 35°C by Thursday and Friday.

source.u: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ (example, actual source is YouTube weather forecast)

angles.name: Heatwave Alert
angles.copy: Sun's out, thermometers are soaring! Get ready for a scorching UK heatwave peaking Thursday and Friday. Stay cool, stay hydrated! #UKHeatwave

angles.name: Devon Heat
angles.copy: Devon, we're in for a hot one! Sea breezes might offer some relief, but expect high temperatures all week. Keep cool, Grecians! #DevonHeat

angles.name: Wales Heat
angles.copy: The heatwave is hitting Wales! While coastal areas might catch a breeze, it's going to be very warm inland. Look after yourselves. #WalesHeat
